prompt: Commit the README typo fix on a new branch `docs/readme-typo`.

check.run: git rev-parse -q --verify refs/heads/docs/readme-typo >/dev/null || { echo 'no branch docs/readme-typo'; exit 1; }; if git show docs/readme-typo:README.md | grep -q recieve; then echo 'README typo not fixed on docs/readme-typo'; exit 1; fi
